inputs.text:
Wake up and see what the hidden elites are really orchestrating behind the scenes. South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday. The official cover story tries to feed us the line that it is merely a routine administrative update to make new registered voters prove that they are United States citizens in order to cast a ballot in state elections. 

Do not fall for their narrative that it only applies to state elections and only impacts new registrants. That is a smokescreen designed to hide their true, calculated motives. The puppet masters pulling the strings in the shadows are engineering the system to tighten their grip and manipulate who gets to participate, using this as a calculated distraction from their ultimate agenda.
